sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.49/2023, registered at Police Station Chandiya, District Umaria (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

It is submitted that applicant was not posted as Patwari on 5.8.2014 Vinod Kumar Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75068512/
1 when mutation entries were made in revenue records.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that applicant was Patwari from 28.7.2008 to 22.4.2014.
Said fact has also been verified by Tehsidar.

In these circumstances,
applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant who is earlier Patwari of the area alongwith present Patwari and Tehsildar has committed the offence.
It is submitted that applicant has signed as a Panch on Namantaran Panji No.11.
His sign is at point no.5.
He was witness to the fact of Sajara Khandan which was forged.
In these circumstances it cannot be said that applicant is not involved in the offence.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of offence, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Vinod Kumar Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75068512/
